questions.enonce_markdown:
The table below shows the population $P$, in thousands to one decimal place, of a certain town $T$ years after 1980.

| $T$ | 1 | 3 | 5 | 7 | 9 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $P$ | 17.8 | 63.1 | 223.9 | 707.9 | 2511.9 |

It is believed that $P$ and $T$ are connected by a law of the form
$$
P = ab^{T}.
$$
By plotting $\log P$ against $T$, estimate to one decimal place, the values of the constants $a$ and $b$. Hence, state the approximate population of this town in 1980. (9 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Linearising.** Take logarithms (base 10) of $P = ab^{T}$:
$$
\log P = (\log b)\,T + \log a.
$$
This is a straight line $Y = mT + c$ with $Y = \log P$ (vertical axis), $T$ (horizontal axis), **gradient** $m = \log b$ and **vertical intercept** $c = \log a$ (the value of $\log P$ at $T = 0$, i.e. in 1980).

**Table of values** ($\log P$ to 3 decimal places):

| $T$ | 1 | 3 | 5 | 7 | 9 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $P$ | 17.8 | 63.1 | 223.9 | 707.9 | 2511.9 |
| $\log P$ | 1.250 | 1.800 | 2.350 | 2.850 | 3.400 |

**The graph.** Use a horizontal scale for $T$ from $0$ to $10$ and a vertical scale for $\log P$ from $0$ to $3.5$ (so that the intercept at $T = 0$ can be read). Plot the five points $(1, 1.250)$, $(3, 1.800)$, $(5, 2.350)$, $(7, 2.850)$, $(9, 3.400)$. They lie close to a straight line (confirming the model $P = ab^T$); draw the line of best fit through the middle of the points and extend it back to the vertical axis ($T = 0$).

**Gradient.** Using two points far apart *on the line* (not necessarily data points), for example $(1,\ 1.26)$ and $(9,\ 3.40)$:
$$
m = \frac{3.40 - 1.26}{9 - 1} \approx 0.27, \qquad b = 10^{m} \approx 10^{0.27} \approx 1.9.
$$
**Intercept.** The line meets $T = 0$ at $\log a \approx 0.99$, so
$$
a = 10^{0.99} \approx 9.8.
$$
(Calculation check with the least-squares line through all five points: gradient $0.2675$, intercept $0.993$, giving $b = 10^{0.2675} = 1.851 \approx 1.9$ and $a = 10^{0.993} = 9.84 \approx 9.8$. The line through the first and last points gives $b \approx 1.86$ and $a \approx 9.6$; a hand-drawn line therefore gives $b = 1.9$ and $a$ between $9.5$ and $10$.)

**Verification of the model.** $P = 9.8 \times 1.9^{T}$ gives $P(5) \approx 243$ and $P(9) \approx 3\,160$ (table: $223.9$ and $2511.9$), so the fit is approximate, as expected from a graphical estimate; the least-squares values ($9.84 \times 1.851^T$) give $P(1) \approx 18.2$, $P(5) \approx 213.8$ and $P(9) \approx 2\,511$.

**Population in 1980.** 1980 corresponds to $T = 0$, so $P = ab^0 = a \approx 9.8$ thousand, that is about $9\,800$ people.
$$\boxed{a \approx 9.8, \qquad b \approx 1.9, \qquad P = 9.8 \times 1.9^{T}; \quad \text{population in 1980} \approx 9.8 \text{ thousand}}$$
